name: A00_3_minus_two_casts_a_red_sorcery_paid_by_tapping_a_mountain
notes: Printed: '[-2]: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.' Shock (red instant) and Crash Through (red sorcery) are both in your graveyard; the -2 targets the SORCERY, so only it is cast (Shock stays), as the ability resolves (a sorcery, at instant timing: CR 608.2g), and its {R} is paid like any cast, by tapping the Mountain (CR 601.2g). Crash Through resolves (you draw a card) and, since it would be put into your graveyard, is exiled instead. Loyalty 5 -> 3.
